plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Omnitron switches. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory used, flash used, module temperature, fan status and speed, power supply status, and interface traffic, for iConverter and ION/IONMM (enterprise PEN 7342).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Per-module CPU utilization of the Omnitron iConverter management module (OMNITRON-EXT-MIB ostSnmpCpuUtilization). The device reports milli-percent (1 = 0.001 percent, range 0-100000); collection divides by 1000 so this metric is a 0-100 percentage. Dimension index is ostModuleIndex (CCSS). Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload or a failing module, and may lead to slow management response.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Per-module RAM currently used by the CPU on the Omnitron iConverter management module (OMNITRON-EXT-MIB ostSnmpRamUsed). The device reports kbytes where 1 indicates 1000 bytes (not 1024); the query multiplies by 1000 so this metric is in bytes. Dimension index is ostModuleIndex (CCSS). The table does not expose RAM total or free, so utilization percent is not derived.

metrics.name: device_flash_used
metrics.description: Per-module flash memory currently used on the Omnitron iConverter management module (OMNITRON-EXT-MIB ostSnmpFlashUsed, optional). The device reports kbytes where 1 indicates 1000 bytes; the query multiplies by 1000 so this metric is in bytes. Dimension index is ostModuleIndex (CCSS). Some modules omit this column.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Per-module temperature of the Omnitron chassis in degrees Celsius: sensor=module is the module internal ambient temperature (OMNITRON-MIB ostEnvironmentalTemperature), sensor=cpu is the CPU ambient temperature (cpuTemperature). A reading of 0 means the module cannot report temperature and is skipped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Per-module fan status (OMNITRON-MIB ostEnvironmentalFan1-3Status), normalized so installedPowered(3) = 1 and installedNotPowered(2) = 2; fans reported as notApplicable or notInstalled are skipped.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Per-module fan speed in RPM (OMNITRON-MIB ostEnvironmentalFan1-3Speed), reported only for installed fans.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Per-module power supply status (OMNITRON-MIB ostEnvironmentalPs1Status / Ps2Status), normalized so installedPowered(3) = 1 and installedNotPowered(2) = 2; supplies reported as notApplicable or notInstalled are skipped.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
